_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE SAFE-conversion example -- a seed-stage company that raised two post-money SAFEs (a $1M note at a $5M cap, a $500K note at a $10M cap with no discount, and a $250K note with only a 20% discount and no cap) which all convert together into a subsequent priced Series A. Demonstrates the defining post-money SAFE property (each capped note keeps exactly its own promised ownership % regardless of how many other notes stack alongside it) plus the cap-vs-discount 'whichever price is lower wins' rule, then feeds the converted SAFE holders straight into finmodel.cap_table.simulate_rounds() for the Series A itself (with its own option-pool top-up) and an exit waterfall.
